changes.summary: This display is the result of a unique initiative: Orsay Lab, a call for projects launched in 2025 and targeting young people between 18 and 25 years old. An invitation to the new generation that aimed to come up with original, socially conscious projects focusing on the Museum’s collections and present-day concerns alike. The call for projects was won by Jad Bestautte, a student in Bourgogne-Franche-Comté, whose aim was to raise awareness on mental health and emotional sensitivity among young people by drawing on the evocative capacities of the Musée d’Orsay’s collections. “I came up with this project with the idea that the Museum could become a meeting place where artworks become fulcrums for interacting with others; a venue where mental health issues have a place. Teenagers monitored by Pitié-Salpêtrière Hospital’s Child and Adolescent Psychiatry Department visited the Musée d’Orsay over the course of several weeks. We looked at the works together. The repeated visits became opportunities for projection, in which 19th-century perceptions resonated with present-day questions and experiences.
